tool.name: SemiBin2
tool.description: Metagenomic binning with semi-supervised deep learning
tool.command: SemiBin2 single_easy_bin \ --input-fasta '$input_fasta' \ --output '$output_dir' \ #if $input_bam: --input-bam '$input_bam' #end if #if $input_abundance: --input-abundance '$input_abundance' #end if #if $environment and str($environment) != 'None': --environment '$environment' #end if #if $sequencing_type and str($sequencing_type) != 'None': --sequencing-type '$sequencing_type' #end if #if $prodigal_output_faa: --prodigal-output-faa '$prodigal_output_faa' #end if #if $allow_missing_mmseqs2: --allow-missing-mmseqs2 #end if #if $cannot_name: --cannot-name '$cannot_name' #end if #if $min_contig_len: --min-contig-len '$min_contig_len' #end if #if $epochs: --epochs '$epochs' #end if #if $recluster: --recluster #end if #if $no_recluster: --no-recluster #end if #if $random_seed: --random-seed '$random_seed' #end if #if $verbose: --verbose #end if #if $quiet: --quiet #end if

param.name: input_bam
param.label: Input BAM file (reads mapped to contigs)

param.name: cannot_name
param.label: Cannot link file name
param.help: Name of the cannot link file

param.name: min_contig_len
param.label: Minimum contig length
param.help: Minimum length of contigs to bin

tool.help:
**What it does**
SemiBin2 is a metagenomic binning tool that uses semi-supervised deep learning to generate high-quality metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) from short- and long-read sequencing data.
**Changes in v2.5.0**
- Added `hybrid` as a synonym for `long_read` in `--sequencing-type` - Deprecated `--prodigal-output-faa` (no longer used) - Deprecated `--allow-missing-mmseqs2` (no-op) - Removed `--environment` parameter from training step (use pretrained models instead)
**Usage**
Run SemiBin2 with a pretrained environment model:
```bash SemiBin2 single_easy_bin -i contigs.fasta -b reads.bam -o output --environment human_gut ```
Or train a new model:
```bash SemiBin2 single_easy_bin -i contigs.fasta -b reads.bam -o output ```
For long-read data:
```bash SemiBin2 single_easy_bin -i contigs.fasta -b reads.bam -o output --sequencing-type long_read ```
For hybrid (long + short) data:
```bash SemiBin2 single_easy_bin -i contigs.fasta -b reads.bam -o output --sequencing-type hybrid ```
**Citation**
Pan S, Zhu C, Zhao XM, Coelho LP. A deep siamese neural network improves metagenome-assembled genomes in microbiome datasets across different environments. *Nature Communications* 2022. DOI: 10.1038/s41467-022-29843-y
Pan S, Zhao XM, Coelho LP. SemiBin2: self-supervised contrastive learning leads to better MAGs for short- and long-read sequencing. *Bioinformatics* 2023. DOI: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btad209
